name: PJ Evans
strengths: Evans brings true 335-pound mass to occupy the interior and move people in the run game.
Evans finishes blocks through the whistle and does not look soft once he latches.
Evans has a compact 6-2 base that can anchor versus interior bull rush when pad level stays right.
weaknesses: Evans still needs to prove lateral range on zone pulls and second-level climbs versus quicker SEC fronts.
comparison: Evans comps to Shaq Mason — compact, powerful interior with mass to move people and enough base to anchor in pass protection.
projection: Evans projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at OG/C (scout / rotation Year 1). Ceiling: multi-year SEC interior starter — the mass-first mauler who can lock down a gap.
schemeFit: Evans fits an interior OG/C room that values mass, finish, and gap integrity over long athletic pulls.
insiderNotes: Evans is a 6-2 / 335 Jackson Academy interior with true mass, finishing mentality, and a compact base to anchor. Wins with power — a space-moving IOL mold Florida can develop into every-down OG/C.
staffNotes: Vault film desk drafted 2026-08-06 from On3/Hudl + board bio. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: PJ Evans is a 3 IOL · listed 6-2 / 335 · Jackson Academy (Jackson, MS) · open-board Florida target.
angle: Lead with 335-pound interior mass + finish; Florida IOL chase.
